final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(record_count) AS overall_avg FROM country_counts), above_average AS (SELECT cc.record_count, cc.record_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share, cc.record_count - t.overall_avg AS excess FROM country_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE cc.record_count > t.overall_avg) SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess_overall_average FROM above_average
